package.name: terrain_recognizer
package.description: Terrain-semantics SLOT for ONS2. One node, swappable backends: the geometric stair_gait detector is the reference implementation, learned backends such as DINOv3 plug in behind the same interface. Publishes terrain_recognizer/TerrainObservation on /terrain_recognizer/status and, for backwards compatibility, the latched JSON verdict on /stair_gait/status that NeuPAN's escape terrain gate consumes.
